en: We were crowned in laurels of white， and delivered to the Skyborn's palace in the heavens.
From there， far above the coils of clouds that held blue sky to green earth， we gazed down at the world as the sun fled over the horizon.
How could war be waged in so perfect a place? It seemed impossible， like a dream.
Our battle was over.
But down below， another struggle was beginning.
Would humanity prove themselves worthy of the Second Age we had won? We watched， and waited...
There was a flash of light， and then a voice cut through the haze， beckoning us.
When we awoke， we found ourselves on human soil. By our side was the black knight， whose cause we now knew was joined with ours.
How strange to think the Earthblood's conqueror， the old man we'd seen as our greatest adversary， might have just saved our lives.
And that his actions， which we once condemned， now bore the tint of justice.
Had we done right for the world?
We had set it free-- but also， cut it loose.
Nothing to tether us， or keep us safe.
Our strength as a race would now be tested in new ways.
We vowed to face that challenge unflinching.
Our victory would mean something... It had to.
We had slain any who dared stand against us.
Had all this killing somehow subtracted from the righteousness of our cause?
We chose not to regret.
It seemed more fitting to honor the lives we had taken...
by building a bright future in their name.
What strength humankind possesses!
We chose to bow to the workings of the universe， saw them as immutable-- but you broke that mold and severed the chains that bind us.
For your courage， I will deliver you back to human soil.
But know this: peace is not yours yet.
He will find a new champion; perhaps he may even champion himself.
And it will fall to you to face him.
We swear to lend you our strength when that hour comes.
Together， we will keep this world you have won safe from his whims.
But remember: power alone will not bring you peace.
Nor will anyone follow you into a future bought with blood.
This， I can tell you from experience.
If you choose to rule the world in the same way you saved it， then I fear one day you and I must clash.
For all our sakes， let us pray that day never comes.
The royal knights are coming!
You have to go. Now!
Protect that sword!
Uh， 'scuse me? Who are you?
Where did SHE come from?
Er， the ladies' room is down the hall， miss.
Dang... Ever heard of knocking?
Okay， this is starting to get weird.
You heard the young lady. To the balcony!
How many men did he...!? That's the sword， no mistake.
Time to make a quick exit， and look cool doing it.
Gonna have to jump. Urp... What floor are we on again?
A true gentleman brings the fight outdoors.
Hey， tell the innkeeper that THIS SHOW ROCKS!
I'll explain later， just--
Ugh， there goes my evening.
But what business could the king's men have with us?
What? I don't even...
Those knights look like they mean business.
The only way out of here is down!
But what if it's room service?
All these soldiers... That sword MUST be the one.
You punks owe me for room and board!
Oh crap. Look at the inn! I smell a lawsuit...
The heat is on. Which means... I had best be off!
Is that satin I smell burning?
You were right， Randy! The Sword of Legend WASN'T just a fairy tale.
Doesn't seem all that-- HYAH!--special， though.
Wh-Whoa! Han， be careful!
That's centuries old! What if it's fragile?
Bah! A sword that breaks is like a dog that meows.
Um， what? A-Anyway， there's no proof we've even got the right sword yet.
You know how to find out? Go stab us some DINNER.
I've got legendary hunger.
Um， how are we supposed to outrun an army!?
Split up. A hundred kittens bite harder than one lion!
It's the sword they want.
But we WORKED for that sword!
We can discuss it later. Just run! Meet you at the cemetery outside of town.
Valgar.
You wound me， Serena.
How could the captain of the Red Order betray her fellow knights?
Did you feel unloved?
I won't let you have the sword.
No?
Then die in disgrace!
Damn their iron deviltry!
Pfft. “Sword of Legend“? This cuts like a butter knife!
How unfair is this!?
So， Death wears metal robes.
No fair!
What did we ever do to you?
Stand back， guys! It's time I took this Sword of Legend through the motions!
Oww! What the... What gives?
Hey! Whose side is he on?
Stop it!
He... he stopped. Wait a second...
You think he has to obey us?
This is incredible.
An undead hero， returned to light our darkened world.
Perhaps it is time you shed a little light of your own.
Holy schnitzel! Where'd they get that big golden freak!?
Rrgh! Kill them swiftly， my pretties! My reputation isn't getting any more reputable!
The answers can wait. Let's give our new ally a command!
How d-d-dare you! No one drags Lord Zur's face through the mud and lives to--
Nyaah! What NOW?
Skeletons!? Eek!
The sword--it's raising a whole army! Will they not serve its cause?
Great， now the dead walk? This warrior sure knows how to liven up a cemetery.
But that armor... Wouldn't royal knights have been interred by the castle?
Looks like our golden child is waking up more corpses.
But what are royal knights doing buried in a commoners' cemetery?
This warrior's power seems to be resonating with the town's cemetery.
A strange thing， though， that these “townsfolk“ are clad in royal armor.
Sweet!
Not even I can raise the dead!
Wait， who buries commoners with swords and armor?
Hey! This is not cool!
I didn't sign up to fight a legion of stinky dead things!
No wonder Kanon insisted the Black Order and I accompany you.
Stealing swords is a thug's job， but a blade that awakens an undead menace?
That's my line of work.
Step aside， Zur.
Heck no! This is my chance to look good...er than I always do!
You， sir， are an assistant. Ahem! Stress on those first three letters.
Have it your way.
Now， my pretties! Fetch me that sword， or it's worm-gut porridge for a week!
Truly impressive.
But I， Lord Zur， will prevail! ...Right after these messages.
Looks like the Sword of Legend already had an owner.
I believed we were searching for the Muramasa.
What blade is this?
My belief is that this sword belonged to a great hero in ages past. The forces of darkness feared its baneful bite--but I never dreamed it had the power to resurrect its former master.
For centuries， the royal line who sit the throne have tried to find this weapon.
Now I understand why. This warrior is capable of ending their wicked reign!
I will admit， the people tire of the crown's attempts to force magic down their throats.
But none of us are fools enough to revolt!
This should have been my battle. Not yours.
But neither did I expect to be so doggedly pursued. Alone， I will not last till dawn. Sadly， neither will you.
If it's a reward you expect for finding the sword， then prepare to fill your wallets with blood and misery.
You are enemies of the throne. If you want to live， we must leave here at once.
My teacher lives in the wildwood. (And he's gonna tan my hide when he finds out about this.)
Enemies， shmenemies. We've got a friggin' undead warrior! What's the problem?
The soldiers assembled in that village plan to rebel against the kingdom. Perhaps they will aid us.
No wonder Kanon insisted the Black Order and I help investigate.
Stealing swords is a job for a thug like Zur， but a blade that awakens an undead menace?
Poor fools. You should have stayed home today.
Rabble! A sharp blade only serves a sharp mind.
I fight to save our land， not for glory or riches.
I'll be on my way now， if you feel sufficiently bloodied.
Nice， let me shake your-- Wait， which piece is your hand?
Sorry we crashed your party and broke all your bones. It happens.
Do I look like I have time for this?
There， had your fun? I'm out of here.
Had enough Randy Fu?
Where did you train， in a barn?
What， did we take a take a wrong turn? Other way， guys!
Stop distracting me! I'm gonna forget the plot!
Well done， friend. I think you nearly scratched me.
Your deaths shall be bricks in the great wall of hope.
Apologies， warriors， but I have no time to waste.
I have a long road ahead， but please， feel free to play amongst yourselves.
Omigosh! How'd I do that?
Potty break!
Sorry， Nicoley's got to save the world. Next time， okay?
Sorry， I know you can't help it， but you're REALLY boring.
This “monster“ looks just like Randy's familiar!
Then you must be his teacher.
Down， bunny! Geez， Randy's familiar never acts this crazy.
Are you his teacher?
Teach? Is that you? Tell Mid to chill out!
What kind of familiar attacks people he KNOWS?
What manner of trickery...
Hmm， this lethal lepus looks very familiar. Do you know a boy named Randy?
Hey， little guy! You look just like Nando!
So the teacher Randy always talks about--I guess that must be you.
Indeed. I taught Randy what spells he knows. But， for all his eagerness， I fear he's still a bit green.
I hope you will accept my apology for Mid's behavior. He's quite protective.
Why hello there， Randy. Back for more magical instruction? Or is little Nando giving you trouble?
Indeed. I taught Randy what spells he knows. I can see you sling a bit of white magic yourself.
It's us who owe an apology. The king's men are out for blood， and now we have brought them to your doorstep.
We didn't think ahead. We've been so busy running from the royal knights...
Hey， MY rabbit behaves! Look， Teach， we really need your help. I kind of， um， went looking for that sword we talked about.
And now we're， um， fugitives， wanted by the kingdom... Oops?
A good thing， that.
I fear you may need his protection again very soon.
We're sorry， too... that RANDY DIDN'T TELL US!
So， you found the sword. Kanon the Grey will stop at nothing to retrieve it. You've brought great danger upon yourselves.
I suppose that deathly warrior over there is somehow connected to all of this? Come， we must find a safer place to discuss this.
Sorry， these bushes are taken.
A mage? Now why would you be cowering in the wildwood? Unless you've been naughty.
Take him away!
You've threatened my kingdom. These crimes must be punished.
Right now!
No， Prince Valgar. Don't soil your blades for these rabble.
Let the Red Order handle this.
You and I can watch from afar， love. Wouldn't want you to get hit by flying bodies.
Well? Kill them!
When I said， “Kill them!“ I was talking to MY men! Rrgh!
Serena captained a soft band of knights， but I will break them--after I break you.
The king's wrath is wakened. We've already bled that rebel village trying to find you. How many more must die?
No one will ever harbor you. Just surrender!
Prince Valgar， stand aside.
Let the Red Knight spill blood.
Katrina!
Going to kill me， boy? Then do it.
If you truly believe murder is royal behavior.
Rrgh...
You've stirred up more than that warrior now.
Kanon will redouble his efforts to capture you.
He'll unleash his sorcery and metal golems upon the land--
I will never let that happen! I have already sworn to bring his tyranny to an end.
Hey! He may have power， but we've got the sword and three hundred pounds of undead fury. I think we can take him.
Don't say any more， Teach. I messed up bad， didn't I?
And this isn't like the time I lit your hair on fire...
We'll stop Kanon. I promise. Magic should be a choice， not royal policy.
When war casts shadows upon my fields， it is my feet I plant.
Yes--feet of defiance! I swear to make a stand against Kanon!
Relax. When life hands you lemons， make some apple juice! Me and Gin'll take Kanon down.
Very well.
Our land does need a savior. I shall pray you are up to the task.
Something else is troubling me. Has that black knight not heard the truth from his father? That their bloodline are not true royalty?
Don't be absurd!
What puppet is so blind as to not see his strings?
He's a willing participant.
If not， how could he go around murdering innocents?
How could he burn farmland to ashes and starve his fellow man? Even if he doesn't know he's a puppet， he still let himself become one. He is guilty!
Whoa whoa， time out. The king's not a king!?
He's got a crown， don't he?
Wait! You're saying somebody just swapped a new king in?
But that's ridiculous! The people would never let that happen... right?
A puppet monarchy?
Then all these radical policies--who devised them if not the king!?
Not true royalty? You mean...
I pay taxes to a FRAUD?
Calm down. You must learn to see more than the truth that is right in front of you.
Not so fast， love!
Sorry， Prince Valgar. She's mine!
You left us， Serena. I'll peel that armor from your corpse.
Knights of the Red Order! Greet your former captain.
Ha! Who trained those wimps? Oh， that's right...
It was YOU.
The king's wrath is wakened.
We've already bled that rebel village trying to find you. How many more must die?
Come， Serena， let us embrace! I must thank you for making me captain!
Run， Lord Kanon!
They are a force of nature!
The black wizard is here!?
There's only room for one
“cannon“ here， and it's me!
Did he just say “Kanon“?
Kanon the Grey serves the royal family!
The king's top advisor... I wonder if he takes advice as poorly as he gives it.
No mage faces the black wizard and lives! I'll， uh... I'll be standing by the door， guys.
Stand your ground， cowards!
Ah， Serena.
Hoping to captain the Red Order again? You know， most traitors have the good sense not to return.
You know full well why I have returned.
Ha ha ha ha!
Do I?
I thought you would take shelter with the resistance. My mistake. I should have kept more soldiers here.
Still， I suppose a pile of dead rebels and their families does make a statement.
Now， your turn. Meet Silver， your executioner!
Die， you impostor!
You destroyed the royal family and replaced them with pawns who forced magic on my people!
Ha ha ha ha! Cracked a few history books， have we? Speaking of impostors...
You posed as a knight and moved up the ranks just to steal information about the sword. Liar liar， Serena.
Whoa， time out! Is that true?
The royal family's a fake?
Yes， well， this has all been very enlightening， but in the end， I still hold power.
Here， why don't you and my pets frolic a bit while I deal with important affairs?
Without these mechs， the castle will be vulnerable.
We can strike Kanon down!
Help me storm the castle， and end his puppet tyranny!
Bam! Who just turned your mechs into wrecks? Me. I did.
Next on the list: Kanon. Come on!
I bet that got their attention.
C'mon! Let's corner Kanon and try to make sense of all this.
The metal puppets have fallen.
Now， to face the puppet wearing a robe and crown.
Look at this mess! My tax money!
C'mon， Goldie， let's make Gramps cough up a refund!
Huh!? Back up.
The king isn't really king!? You lying son of a cyclops!
A puppet monarchy!
No wonder the people suffer.
Hey! What did I miss?
What are you talking about?
What has gotten into the royal knights?
They've never attacked the village head on!
Save... the villagers... Nngh...
Rebels never say... dnnnngh...
Once I have you in the air， you will never know the peace of crashing to the ground!
I'd stay， were you worth the effort of sharpening my sword.
Why stay? Will swatting flies make me stronger?
Weaker than week-old bread!
Sorry， but the village is kind of under attack， y'know?
You just flopped worse than Nando's ears.
Sucks to be you!
Keep still. It will hurt less.
Another day， perhaps.
Apologies， warriors， but time is of the essence.
Omigosh! I should make a career out of this!
See my smiley? He's frowning at you.
Nya ha ha! The jig is up， rebel sympathizers! I knew you were all in cahoots.
You cannot pull the wool over Lord Zur's eyes. Now perish!
Mother bucket! What the heck is that!?
At last! It's activating! Hear thee， Golem God! I order you to destroy all who  serve the royal bloodline!
Mommy... Why do the big creatures always hate me?
SERVANTS OF THE ROYAL BLOODLINE... DETECTED!
Interesting.
Hey! Not at us!
Bwa ha ha! That machine knows its bloodlines!
And apparently， so do you.
Bah! Where's the glory in offing some green-armored wimp?
You nincompoops are the only fugitives that matter. Now get ready for a Zur-prise!
There! I like these odds better! Attack， my pretties!
Have you all lost your mind?
How dare you lay your hands on me--a national treasure! Lord Kanon will hear of this!
Why not go cry to the king?
...Because you know the truth.
I watched you at the castle. You always had a hand in Kanon's slimiest affairs.
He told you， didn't he?
That he destroyed the true royal family. That the king we have now is just a puppet--
A dictator he put on the throne to seize power!
What!?
The king is a fraud?
You... you... you you YOU YOU YOU'RE NOT SUPPOSED TO KNOW THAT!
You're just a lowly knight- captain with a... with a big golden freak for a friend!
Grrr... Hmph! So be it. The gloves are off. Schnitzel is about to get very， very real.
I will punish you as only Lord Zur can...
By disappearing!
Serena， I served in the Blue Order. If the king's not a king， then am I not a knight?
I don't have all the answers.
But I promise you: Kanon will not stop at forcing magic and machinery into our lives.
He has some higher goal. Something that drives him...
Like I care what makes him tick! He's a liar who's deceived us all.
I'll tear down his little puppet show myself.
Yeowch! What's the big idea?
Stop! We are not the enemy!
Ack! What's it doing? Somebody call tech support!
No way! So it's not that the king had a change of heart-- WE had a change of king!
Puppet!? Is that true?
Time out there， honey.
The king's a fraud?
So the king is a fake?
I can hardly believe it...
All this time， we've been jerked around by a phony king?
Yeah， it's called insanity!
He thinks he can lie to us and get away with it? He can think again! Right， Nando?
These are dark times， when demons like him call themselves men. He will pay for deceiving the people!
You know what we need? Someone of true royal blood! They'd know what to do.
Behold! How we burst from our skin-tight suits! Lo! Are our visages not awesomely cute?
Wow! It's us!  The kleptomaniacal Glutes!
Hey. Nice to rob ya.
You buttinskies picked a bad day to crash Macho's turf.
Macho demands appeasement in the form of that golden dude! Hand him over.
Never. He serves the kingdom， not rabble like you!
Ha! Good luck talking the “golden dude“ into it.
Have it your way. But Macho warns you! Peter Piper never picked pectorals like THESE.
Wait， boss! Me and the boys'll bump these guys off. Watch!
How dare you send Macho's Glutes down the chute!? Grr...
You wield much strength， but Macho senses you are bullies.
Boss! It's the royal knights!
Here to set Macho up? Hmph! You can go， trespassers. Your beating will come later!
Macho must stay and pump iron. Pink， knightly iron!
Eep! Macho has decided Macho is too manly to fight girly royal lapdogs. Come， Glutes! Strut away swiftly， that we may rob another day!
Ha! He wouldn't be caught undead in that outfit!
A wise man does not take that which will destroy him.
Sorry! You're not his type!
Wha-Wha-Wha what what what WHAT ARE YOU DOING HERE? Didn't Valgar kill you yet?
Don't just stand there， my pretties! Death formation!
Nya ha ha! I suppose you were hoping to pop in on your rebel villager friends?
Well， too bad! Because I “popped“ them first! They are now bloody cherries on my sundae of glory!
My genius plan was to frame those muscly thugs for murder-- WAY TO RUIN IT!
Now the king looks bad， I look bad--and you're gonna look dead!
Are you insane? How dare you strike a member of the court! I am nobility!
You're a noble liar!
You know the truth. I watched you at the castle.
You always had a hand in Kanon's slimiest affairs. He told you， didn't he?
That he destroyed the true royal family. That the king we have now is a puppet--a dictator he put on the throne to seize power!
What!? The king is a fraud?
What? Somebody changed kings on us? But that's... crazy...
WHO TOLD YOU THAT!? You're just a knight-captain!
A traitor with a big， ugly， smelly， golden， zombie LOSER  for a friend!
Ugh， I cannot win. Lord Zur is defeated! Lord Zur will kiss your boots and praise your name!
Pfft， in another lifetime!
So the king's not a king?
So the king's a fake?
I can hardly believe it.
It must come as a shock.
But Kanon will not stop at forcing magic into our lives.
He has some higher goal... something that drives him.
Like I care what makes him tick! He's a liar.
And I'm gonna make him pay.
Yeah， it's called insanity! He has no right to lie to us.
Me and Nando won't allow it!
These are dark times.
How can demons like him call themselves men? He will pay for deceiving the people!
You know what we need? Someone of true royal blood! They'd know how to fix all this.
Gotta be at least one of 'em left somewhere， right?
Valgar. We're too late.
That knight!? How did he get here so fast?
I'm starting to feel like the ham on a knight sandwich.
The black knight... Tremendous. Few could mobilize their forces this quickly.
An ambush? You can't ambush me! I AMBUSH YOU FIRST!
So a common mage's power cannot hold you. No matter.
My quarrels， I prefer to settle with blades.
A shame this fun won't last.
S-Stand your ground， men! They are lawless weaklings!
Hmph. I may have misjudged that monster's strength， but--
Hey， what are you-- Ow! Trample THEM， not me!
Enough!
Come， men!
Well well， if it isn't my favorite gaggle of rebel sympathizers.
A shame you missed the magic as I ground your co-traitors into hamburgers! But fear not. My powerful golem will ensure that you--wait for it--ketchup.
How dare you ruffle my... my royal neck ruffle!
This is property of the king!
Liar!
The king is an imposter.
You always had a hand in Kanon's slimiest affairs.
So you know he destroyed the true royal family. The king we have now is a puppet he put on the throne to gain power!
A royal switch?
Puppet!? Surely that can't be true?
H-HOW DO YOU KNOW THAT!?
You're just a knight-captain! A traitor with a big golden FREAK for a friend.
If you're not going to play fair... then take this! My ultimate weapon--
Hyper Dimensional Parallel Extra Strong Super Attack... HOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO! ...HO?
Ho crap， it's not working.
I don't know the whole story.
He thinks he can lie to us and get away with it? No way!
These warriors...
They died in another age.
Was there a war fought here? I don't savor killing men who already gave their life once.
Magic didn't bring these warriors back. Hatred did. You feel that rage in the air?
I sense agony in this place. These fields were watered with blood. I wonder...
Who were these men?
A war must've been fought here long ago. The souls of the dead are screaming! Either that， or I have a migraine.
Rrgh. Here already? It's these ghoulish pests...
Have the dead no honor， attacking their fellow knights?
Fellow knights? No... My ancestors lie here.
Rest now， kindred spirits. I promise you， the true monarchy you fought for will never be stamped out by the likes of him.
I'm starting to understand...
This must be where the true royal family lies buried.
Ohhh. I get it now.
This is where the real royalty was buried.
You question their honor， but I know it to be real.
These warriors died in defense of the true monarchy.
Well， wouldn't you be ticked off if a bunch of impostors came along and stole your king's throne?
What?
You're speaking nonsense.
Huh? Something's...
Ah! Feel that hatred! This warrior is unlike any we have faced!
A captain? No， a general!
Whoever he was， he's on nobody's side now.
Oh my grog. N-Nando， did you just wet yourself?
